seo.title: Services | Mohit Walia
seo.description: Web development, Next.js, commerce, automation, AI features, APIs, and technical consulting from Mohit Walia.

hero.heading: Services that help businesses build, scale, and automate.
hero.description: Product engineering, commerce platforms, and the automation around them. Each engagement is scoped around a release you can use, not a catalogue of hours.

why.heading: A senior builder, not a rotating cast.
why.description: You work with the person who writes the code and explains the tradeoffs. The process stays visible from the first call to launch.

items.title: Direct collaboration
items.detail: No account layer between you and the work. Questions get an answer from the person building it.

items.title: A release, not a pile of tasks
items.detail: We agree what the first version must do, then build that before the extras.

items.title: Stack you can keep
items.detail: Next.js, Node, WordPress, Shopify, or Webflow. The choice follows the product, and you are not locked into a private framework.

items.title: Remote, on purpose
items.detail: Calls are in India Standard Time, with overlap for US and UK hours when the work needs it.

process.heading: From the first call to a release you can run.
process.description: Five steps. The same shape on every service, with the details changed to fit the product.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.detail: We pin down the outcome, the constraints, and what the first release has to do.

steps.title: Planning
steps.detail: I turn that into a scope, a sequence, and the technical approach.

steps.title: Development
steps.detail: I build in small slices you can review, on the stack this service uses.

steps.title: Testing
steps.detail: We check the flows that matter before anything is treated as finished.

steps.title: Launch
steps.detail: I ship it, watch the first days, and leave you with a clear way to change it.

faqs.heading: Before we start.
faqs.description: If your question is not here, send it on WhatsApp.

items.question: How do we begin?
items.answer: Send a note with what you want to ship. If it is a fit, we book a short call and agree the first release.

items.question: Do you work with teams outside India?
items.answer: Yes. Most of the work is remote. Calls are scheduled in India Standard Time.

items.question: Can you join a product that already exists?
items.answer: Yes. I read the current system first and change the part you hired me for.

items.question: What does the first call cover?
items.answer: The product, the timeline, and what version one must do. It is about 30 minutes.

cta.heading: Ready to build your next product?
cta.description: Tell me what you want to ship. I will reply on WhatsApp, and we can book a call if the project is a fit.

enquiry.responseTime: I reply on WhatsApp, usually the same day.
